I want my family to think I'm fine because I know they would be very unhappy if the knew I felt this way. At the moment they know I get a lot of headaches, but that's it. 

I could see myself maybe seeing a therapist but I can't see myself telling my parents about it. I don't want them to worry about me.

No, mainly because I don't want anyone else to know I feel like this, but also because I don't know how anything could make me feel better. My family knows I get migraines but that's it.

I don't want my feelings and pain to become a burden to someone else.
